findings.whyItMatters: Startup entries from unknown publishers deserve verification.
findings.whyMightBeNormal: Smaller legitimate software vendors may not have widely recognized publisher names.
findings.title: Unknown Publisher in Run Key: SyncHelper

findings.whyItMatters: WMI subscriptions are a stealthy, fileless persistence method.
findings.title: No WMI Event Subscriptions

findings.detail: Action: powershell.exe -w hidden -enc SQBFAFgAIAAoAE4AZQB3AC0ATwBiAGoAZQBjAHQAIABOAGUAdAAuAFcAZQBiAEMAbABpAGUAbgB0ACkA... | Runs as: SYSTEM | Trigger: every 15 minutes
findings.whyItMatters: A hidden, encoded PowerShell task masquerading under a Microsoft folder is a common persistence technique.
findings.whyMightBeNormal: Some management agents use encoded commands, but rarely under a Microsoft task path.
findings.title: Scheduled Task Runs Encoded PowerShell: \Microsoft\Windows\UpdateOrchestrator\SyncCheck
